title: Final review of the Phase 5a diff
description:
Review the full epic diff. Three things:

1. IS THE CUT ACTUALLY COMPLETE? Grep cmd/tk/cmd/{cloud,factory}*.go yourself for every ticks internal/ import. The phase's whole claim is that these files could be lifted into another repo and still compile. Test that claim directly rather than reading the diff: what would 'go build' say if this directory were a different module?

2. NOTHING PROMOTED. Every phase of this project has had the same negative acceptance — no package leaves internal/, no new exported API is created to serve the factory. Confirm it, and note that copies are the intended answer here.

3. THE --all TRAP. If any tk list call walks descendants without --all, that is a silent correctness bug: tk list defaults to the caller's own ticks and an epic's descendants are filed by whoever created them. Phase 1 paid for this once. Check every call site, and check the tests would catch its removal rather than merely passing today.

Commit RESULT-<id>.md — for a review tick the report is the deliverable.
acceptance_criteria: Every remaining internal/ import in the factory command files is enumerated and each is either gone or justified. Nothing was promoted out of internal/. Every tk list descendant walk uses --all and a test would catch its removal. go test ./... green.
